title: A list's selection bar still draws a bulk action that a disabled package withholds, as a ghost button that toasts "not executable"
body:
## Source

Measured by HotCRM on platform **18.3.0** (hotcrm `main` `f98025c`, fresh dev boot, admin) while finishing hotcrm#2383. The implementer's report is [hotcrm#2383 comment 6638927959](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2383#issuecomment-6638927959). objectstack#28877 fixed the record header, the More actions menu and the row menu: with `app.objectstack.hotcrm.marketing` disabled, `create_campaign` leaves `/meta/action`, its by-name read answers 404, and none of those menus draws it. One surface still draws it.

| # | Observed on 18.3.0 | Seam | Suggestion |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Marketing disabled. **Leads → All Leads**, tick a row. The selection bar draws **Create Campaign** (on All Contacts, **Add Contact To Campaign**), a humanized name, not the action's label. Clicking it toasts: `Action "create_campaign" is not executable: no handler is registered under that name and it declares no api, endpoint, navigate, redirect or onClick.` With marketing on, the same bar draws **Add to Campaign**, which works. | `ListView.bulkActions` names the action as a bare string. In the renderer, `plugin-grid` `resolveBulkActions` keeps a name it cannot resolve (pinned in `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/bulkActionMembers-8071.test.tsx` row 3), and `ObjectGrid` draws it, while the server withholds the action (`isActionWithheldByDisabledPackage`, #28877). | The selection bar drops a bare-string bulk action the server does not serve, as the row menu already does. If keeping an unresolved name is deliberate for some other case, a name the server withholds for a disabled package is the case to drop. |

HotCRM declares these bulk actions as bare strings, which the spec accepts, and has nothing to change on its side. hotcrm#2383 closes with its tests and docs. HotCRM re-measures the bar when its pin carries this fix.

Filing gate **① a reproduced defect.** Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`huangyiirene`, session `session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5`).

**Grade: `priority:p3`.** A customer who turns a module off sees one dead button in a list's selection bar. Nothing is written. **Size: S.**

**Dedupe:** searched open objectstack issues for `bulkActions unresolved`, `resolveBulkActions`, `not executable bulk` and `withheld action selection bar`. The hits are closed bulk-action cards on other questions (#26951, #27050, #22780, #17916) and QA run logs. #28877, now closed, covered the other menus and not the selection bar.

<sub>Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` lane seat from hotcrm#2383's out-of-scope finding.</sub>
